items.verse: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَصِيًّۭا
items.verseEn: O my father, do not worship [i.e., obey] Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.
And his mother and his father

items.verse: قَالَ هَلْ عَلِمْتُم مَّا فَعَلْتُم بِيُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ إِذْ أَنتُمْ جَـٰهِلُونَ
items.verseEn: He said, "Do you know what you did with Joseph and his brother when you were ignorant?"

items.verse: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ ٱلْبَنَـٰتِ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ ۙ وَلَهُم مَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
items.verseEn: And they attribute to Allāh daughters - exalted is He - and for them is what they desire [i.e., sons].

categories.name: أَحْدَاثُ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي سُورَةِ النَّازِعَاتِ
categories.nameEn: Events of the Day of Judgment in Surah An-Nazi'at

items.verseEn: There will follow it the subsequent [one].
And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.
Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.

items.verse: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
items.verseEn: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.

categories.name: أَلْفَاظٌ خَاصَّةٌ بِالْكَافِرِينَ فِي سُورَةِ الْمُلْكِ
categories.nameEn: Distinctive terms for the disbelievers in Surah Al-Mulk

items.verse: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
items.verseEn: Do you feel secure that He who is above would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?

items.verse: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّۢ وَنُفُورٍ
items.verseEn: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.

items.verse: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
items.verseEn: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

items.verse: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
items.verseEn: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered: whether Allāh should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"
Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
Taught man that which he knew not.
